narration: The audience gasps in unison. Somewhere, a producer is weeping with joy.
speaker: HOST CHAD BELLAMY-OKAFOR
line: A tabloid! In my house! I haven't been this thrilled since the sommelier incident.
confessional: I'd like to thank the goat. Without the goat, I'm just a man with a clipboard.
memory: Chad is delighted by your confession.

choices.text: Demand a cut of your own tabloid.
Name the goat as your source.
